通道连接时防止系统空闲睡眠，不影响锁屏或屏幕休眠。关机、注销和合盖休眠仍会中断任: Prevent idle sleep while connected. Your display can still sleep or lock. Shutdown, sign-out and closing the lid can interrupt tasks.

通过腾讯 iLink 扫码绑定，凭据保存在此 Mac 的钥匙串。当前支持一对一文: Pair through Tencent iLink. Credentials stay in this Mac's Keychain. Supports one-to-one text messages.

使用 /agent 查看和切换可用 Agent，使用 /projects、/se: Use /agent to switch agents, /projects and /sessions to choose a conversation, or /status to check the current target.
